get.description: Lists every Project of the Account, by name, as the Projects page does. The list is not paged. Each row carries `id`, `name`, and `statusPageSlug`, the address segment of the Project's public status page.

post.description: Creates an Input as the New Input page does. `url` is required, absolute, and stored lower case without query string and fragment; a Smoke Test has one Input per address. `fields` lists the form's fields as `name`, `type`, `value`, and for a select `options`. A `password` field's value is stored encrypted and never returned. A blank or relative `url`, one the Smoke Test has an Input for, and fields without a name or type answer 422. Answers 201 with the Input.

get.description: Pages through the pages of one Run, as the Run page does, with the total count. `page` (from 1, default 1) and `pageSize` (1 to 250, default 50) page the list on the server; a value out of range is brought into range, and a page past the last answers no rows. `errors` is `All` (default), `WithErrorsOnly`, or `WithoutErrorsOnly`. `ignored` is `All`, `UnignoredOnly` (default, as the page opens), or `IgnoredOnly`. `search` matches part of the URL, ignoring case. `sortBy` is `url` (default), `status`, `loadTime`, or `issues`; any other value sorts by URL. `sortDirection` is `Ascending` (default) or `Descending`. Each row says whether its URL is `ignored`.

post.description: Adds a site to monitoring as the New Health Check page does. `name` and `url` are required. The URL must be absolute and its root domain a Verified Domain of the Account: add and verify it with `verified-domains.add` and `verified-domains.verify` first, or the call answers 422 on `url`. It creates the web-application Service and its check, runs the uptime and SSL checks now so the first datapoint exists, and queues the SSL Labs analysis. Answers 201 with the Service's id, name, and URL.
